posts.subject: VinceG
posts.bodyHtml:
Hello everyone im here to talk about the administrator VinceG.


(Surf DM RPG server)


THE THIRD BAN EXPLAINS EVERYTHING IF YOU DON'T LIKE TO READ JUST IGNORE THE FIRST 2 BANS.


First of all VinceG abused his powers.


When I started playing the server I didn't know about the rule spawn killing. So yeh I hit some people from my spawn (But I did not kill anyone). VinceG banned me directly. He did not warn me through a mic and did not slayed me. Please keep in mention I did not know about the rule. As you guys could see in the picture that was my first ban. ''Hat sich entschuldigt und Reue gezeigt. Sollte sich jetzt regelkonform verhalten.'' Yes I got unbanned after some hours after I explained him that I am new and did not know about the rule.


[Bild]


My second ban was a accident by me and yes I did spawn kill here. I thought the enemy spawn was a jail xD. Same like the first ban he banned me directly and there were no warnings again. I waited that ban fully out.


[Bild]


The third ban is starting to get interest. I was on top tried to shot some surfers. Suddenly some people started to hit me from their spawn (Abusing the spawn rule). So ofc I shot back because I can defence myself if someone abuses the rule. After I killed some spawn killers VinceG came in the server and banned me for 1 month. 1 MONTH YES THATS TRUE! I ofc protested my ban on this forum and explained everything in the protest.


[Bild]


But I did not get a response in 24 hours. So I started to pm VinceG private. But like I expected he ignored me.


[Bild]


So after this I started to pm a other admin. That admin replied directly and told me that he wasn't there so he couldn't do anything about it. I started to pm some higher admins like Admins D and the head admin but had no luck. Day later I started to talk in the shoutbox and VinceG changed the ban in a PERM BAN. Because ''Telling lies'' What is not true.''Breaking rules'' I did not break any rule. ''Annoying other admins''. I just pmed like 3-4 admins 1x each. How is that being annoying? I pmed 3-4 admins because none gave me a proper answer.


[Bild]



So my question is why is VinceG abusing his powers?????????? Why does he warns other people 3x before banning (Also the people who play daily) them and me 0 warnings. At the thrid ban a German person also did the same like me. Defending himself and shooting back to people who starting to shoot from their spawn. Why did VInce only ban me? And not the German guy???


OT: Sorry for my bad English.

Zitat von VinceG

I said i will ban you for 1 Month / 4 Weeks if i see you breaking any rule again.


You got your perm ban because you are annoying. I changed the 4 weeks to 3 weeks and you still annoyed everyone.


I have never abused my admin rank and i will never abuse it.
I warned the other guys and they stopped... but you got warned so often.


2 Weeks... be quiet now and accept the 2 week ban.

Well... i think i change the 2 weeks back to perm. 🙂


Btw... i warned you so often and i explained the rules so often to you.

My friend, we said it so many times, you dont have to shoot out of your spawn.
You DONT care what we said (Pixel, VinceG and me)
And Vince slayed you many times, and you got many kicks for that

@2


Yeh you finally pmed me back just like 10 mins ago. Because I started to bitch in the shoutbox.

@3


I know the rules and I cared about what you guys said.
Did you even read my topic? Like I said about the third ban I did not shoot from my spawn, I shot from top. The enemy shot me from their spawn so I shot back whats wrong with that?

I connected with one of my other accounts and you instantly killed me 3 Times.


I sawed nobody shooting from the spawn... they had not even the chance to shoot back.

@7


They cleary shot me ... They watched to top with like 5 man..

Also VinceG,


du kannst ihn gerne einen Bann geben wenn er sich nicht an die Regeln hält. Ein permabann jedoch nicht dann wenn er versucht sich zu erklären.


Wie auch schon noeN sagt, habt ihr es ihm oft erklärt, ich hoffe er hat es jetzt eingesehen. Lass ihm seinen 2 Wochen Bann absitzen und geb ihm eine letzte Chance.


Wenn er dann weiter macht kann er ausgeschlossen werden vom Server.


______________________________________________________________________________________________


copp1k1lla,


other people say also that you did Spawnkills. You will get your 2 weeks ban from VinceG


I hope you will learn about this, otherwise you will get a much longer ban!

So it's closed now. You know what you did wrong. So wait 2 weeks then you can play again.
